title: Modern Bento Grid
description: A modular asymmetric grid that balances visual interest and scannability.
prompt: Create a responsive bento grid section with varied card spans, strong content hierarchy, consistent gaps, and intentional visual rhythm. Every card must communicate a distinct feature with concise copy. Avoid arbitrary sizes and empty decorative blocks. Stack gracefully on mobile and preserve reading order.

title: Single Column
description: Long reads, blogs, and mobile reading.
prompt: Build a responsive Single Column web page layout for long reads, blogs, and mobile reading. Keep one centered reading column with a constrained line length, a lead image, and a clear heading hierarchy. Inspect and adapt the existing project components, routing, stack, and design tokens before implementing. Use realistic content, semantic landmarks, accessible contrast, visible keyboard focus, and meaningful image alternatives. Keep controls functional. Prevent horizontal overflow at 320px and preserve readability at 200% zoom. Respect reduced-motion preferences.
